pictures.observations: Actually viewed fully loaded full-width bowl from beneath the canopy: rectangular underside rafters/diagonals, open opposite long stand and open ends, two tiers with a central hospitality band, warm multicolor seat sectors and supported end display/light frames. Confirms one covered western stand rather than a full ring or two completed canopies. No current-date or exact seat inventory claim.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific Peter Mokaba Stadium: native oval bowl/open central floor, one completed western side canopy with closed pale skins/underside rafters and green arched girder, four rounded concrete circulation trunks/open helical ramp approximations with white branches on the two canopy-supporting western cores, warm orange/sand/brown two-tier seating set inside the corner circulation cores/radial aisles/central hospitality band, recessed concrete service facade/closed entries, neutral football field/markings/goals and independently supported end boards/light frames. Five existing shared concrete/paint/standing-seam/window-grid/canvas graphs. Opposite long stand and both ends remain uncovered. No proposed full roof, old neighboring stadium, whole sports campus/parking slab, copied crowd/event artwork or furnished service interior.
